grammar_card.title: 句子的骨架(用本课句子看懂它)
grammar_card.intro: 先认识句子的几个"零件",再做题就不抽象了。下面全用本课句子举例。

rows: 主语 = 句子在说"谁/什么"
The play was really funny.(主语 = The play)
谓语动词 = 主语"做什么/是什么"
The play was really funny.(谓语 = was)
系动词 = 不表动作,像"等号",连接主语和描述(be / look / feel / get)
I got angry.(系动词 = got,"变得"生气)
表语 = 系动词后面补充说明主语的词
The play was really funny.(表语 = really funny)
宾语 = 动作落在谁/什么上
I couldn't hear the actors.(宾语 = the actors)
She gave me a great seat.(me + a great seat)

specialRules.rule: 宾语补足语 = 补充说明宾语;判别法:中间加 be 能成句 → They made him captain(him is captain ✓)

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — Why was the writer unhappy at the theater?

passage: Last Friday I went to the theater downtown. I had a great seat, right in the center. The play was a comedy, and it was really funny. But I didn't enjoy it at all. A young couple was sitting behind me, and they were talking loudly the whole time. I got angry because I couldn't hear the actors. I turned around and looked at them, but they didn't pay any attention. In the end I couldn't bear it. I turned around again. "I can't hear a word!" I said angrily. "It's none of your business," the young man said rudely. "This is a private conversation!"

stage5.stem: 选出语序正确的句子:
options: Yesterday I went to the theater.
I went yesterday to the theater.

To the theater I went yesterday.

stage5.stem: 时间状语可放句首或句尾。下列哪句与 "Every morning she reads the news" 同义且正确?
options: She reads the news every morning.
She every morning reads the news.
Reads she the news every morning.
She reads every morning the news.

"She gave me a great seat." 换一种说法:She gave a great seat ___ me.
The pizza smells ___.

stage5.stem: 哪句是复合宾语?(判别法:宾语后面加 be 能成句,如 him is captain)
把 "He likes the play." 变否定:
下列哪个否定式没有缩写形式?

"Is this your seat?" 的正确肯定回答:
